overview.description: The Frontier Economic Fund (AKAF) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the The Alaska Last Frontier index. The fund tracks a tier-weighted index that invests in equity securities of companies engaged in business activities connected to the state of Alaska. The fund is designed in partnership with the State of Alaska Department of Revenue AKAF was launched on Jun 25, 2025 and is issued by Alaska.
